Anant Singh, Pawan Singh News: anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi men umri bhari bhir ne sabka dhyan khincha. is dauran bhir ko dekhkar anant sinh bhavuk najar aae aur yah pal charcha ka vishay ban gaya. dekhie anant sinh ka yah khas vidiyo aur janie puri kahani sirph Bihar Tak par.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
